name: TN Brain · 22 · Morning brief - Kiera (weekdays 08:00, needs TN_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN)

parameters.query:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.name FROM accounts a JOIN people pe ON pe.id IN (a.client_partner, a.client_director)
  WHERE lower(pe.email) = 'kiera.battersby@tecknuovo.com')
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'risks', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT s.id, s.summary, s.suggested_action, m.name AS account, s.details->>'band' AS band
    FROM signals s JOIN mine m ON m.id = s.account_id
    WHERE s.status = 'new' AND s.type = 'risk' AND s.details->>'band' IN ('Critical','High')
    ORDER BY CASE s.details->>'band' WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.created_at DESC LIMIT 3) x), '[]'::jsonb),
 'opps', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(y) FROM (
    SELECT s.id, s.summary, m.name AS account FROM signals s JOIN mine m ON m.id = s.account_id
    WHERE s.status = 'new' AND s.type = 'opportunity' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 2) y), '[]'::jsonb),
 'new_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM signals s JOIN mine m ON m.id = s.account_id
    WHERE s.status = 'new' AND s.created_at > now() - interval '1 day')
) AS ctx;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.user.id, text: $('Build brief').first().json.text, unfurl_links: false }) }}

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO slack_users (email, slack_user_id) VALUES ('{{ $('Build brief').first().json.email }}', '{{ $('Find Slack user').first().json.user.id }}') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET slack_user_id = EXCLUDED.slack_user_id; UPDATE brief_items SET recipient = '{{ $('Find Slack user').first().json.user.id }}' WHERE recipient = '{{ $('Build brief').first().json.email }}';
